indicators: Candle body average (EMA of body), trend test
entry_long: Down-trend context, then bullish engulfing: white long-body bar after a small black body bar with close >= previous open and open <= previous close (and at least one strict inequality).
exit: Target profit 1% and stop loss 1% (inputs) via strategy.exit.
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Entry order is a limit at the pattern bar open price variable ("o"); exact trend test C_DownTrend is a script helper. Long-only despite "Buy&Sell" title (short side shown as signal).
